prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1370; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with reported head trauma and subsequent concussion symptoms. Over four clinic visits, care consisted of symptom monitoring, cognitive rest guidance, graded return-to-activity instructions, and periodic neurological screening. Several examination findings are consistent with a concussive injury, including reported headache sensitivity and mild balance complaints on exertion, while other testing, including cranial nerve evaluation and reflex assessment, remained within normal limits. At this stage it is not yet clear whether the injury is attributable to this collision, and further correlation with imaging history and symptom timeline is advised. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the history obtained. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as the patient's symptoms improved, with the most recent visit documenting substantial resolution. Billing records reflect one charge per encounter with no repeated or duplicate entries.
